# Conformance Directory

This directory contains auto-generated conformance artifacts from the clean-room CI pipeline.

## CONFORMANCE.md

Generated on every CI run by `scripts/verify.js --output conformance/CONFORMANCE.md --ci`. Contains:

- Per-vector pass/fail results for all 75 vectors (63 static DO + 12 audit hash)
- Verification method description
- Clean-room guarantee (SDK absence confirmed at CI startup)

**Do not edit manually.** This file is regenerated by CI on every push.

## How It Works

```
CI Job: clean-room-verify
  ├─ Step 0: Assert ERDL SDK NOT importable (hard fail if it is)
  ├─ Step 1: npm install json-canonicalize (JCS library only, not ERDL SDK)
  ├─ Step 2: node verify.js (self-built JCS + SHA-256)
  └─ Step 3: Output → conformance/CONFORMANCE.md
```

## Relationship to Answers File

The answers file (`decision-object-answers-v1.3.json`) is **local only, never committed**. The clean-room verifier reads it during CI (from CI secrets or a protected storage path) but it never enters the repository. Runners must implement their own JCS — no canonical bytes are exposed in the vector file.
